annotation.title_clean: Directive 98/79/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 October 1998 on in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.title_en: Directive 98/79/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 October 1998 on in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 331
annotation.summary_en: EU Directive 98/79/EC harmonises rules for in vitro diagnostic medical devices: essential safety and performance requirements, conformity assessment with notified bodies for high-risk lists, CE marking, manufacturer registration, a vigilance system and a European databank. It has no AI or robotics content and was later replaced by Regulation (EU) 2017/746.
key_provisions_or_claims: Devices must meet Annex I essential requirements to be placed on the market
Tiered conformity assessment: manufacturer self-declaration, with notified body involvement for Annex II List A and B devices
CE marking required; free movement of conforming devices
Vigilance procedure and European databank for incident reporting and registrations
Notified bodies designated by Member States under Annex IX criteria
